statement: Every pattern in the epic budget is held by a one-way ratchet: scripts/check-guideline-navigability.js reads the shared detector module, records a per-violation baseline JSON per pattern in the guideline-check-shared.js shape with --update-baseline and the tighten hint, is chained into npm run audit:guidelines and so into test:static and the pre-push gate, and docs/development/code-style.md names each pattern together with the form that replaces it; the budget row navigability_patterns_without_ratchet reads zero. The audit covers the fallback family too (two-source reads, typeof dual paths, catch-and-default, alias exports, legacy vocabulary), each with its own baseline file.

constraints.statement: Writing the baseline at the current count is the only permitted baseline write in this quest; every later write may only lower a count. A new violation anywhere fails test:static.
The audit imports scripts/checks/code-navigability-detectors.js. It carries no detection of its own.

Each pattern's entry in docs/development/code-style.md states the replacement form (named collaborator, owner-held field, decoder, named state, always-promise), so an agent reading a violation knows what to write instead.
The audit exits non-zero on growth and prints the tighten hint when a count falls below its baseline; a mode that cannot fail is not a check.
